title: Big-Titty Train Temptation

body.intro:
Her job was to go undercover, putting herself in dangerous situations to catch criminals… but little did she know, this dream job would soon become a brutal nightmare…

・All exits have been blocked… There is no escaping now.

・These criminals crave revenge and will do whatever they have to do to get it.

・Locked in a room, she is continuously trained both day and night...

・With her body and mind broken, she slowly gives in...

Asami Mizuse is an undercover investigator working for a secret government task force that conducts staged sting operations to study and prevent public harassment. Her mission is to ride the train and gather behavioral data by participating in controlled simulations with actors and repeat test subjects who previously agreed to cooperate with the program.

During one assignment, the scenario becomes unexpectedly intense when several participants deviate from the script, turning the operation into an improvised stress test. Asami is quickly relocated to a monitoring room where the team continues the evaluation under supervision.

Unsure what surprises the staff have planned next, Asami must keep her composure and complete the experiment while navigating various unpredictable, yet fully regulated, simulation challenges designed to test her professionalism.

・Asami Mizuse (VA: Kikyo Yamamoto)

The heroine of this story. A 25-year-old woman who works investigating harassment cases. She is highly ambitious and one of the elite members of her organization.

She didn't think much of her breast size as a student, but ever since she started this job, she has become proud of what she's got.

She has a high sense of pride and is strong-willed no matter who she is interacting with. But despite this, she easily crumbles when persistently teased.

She has no experience with men and thinks sex is impure.

・Shuri Kitami (VA: Azuki Amasake)

The heroine's colleague. She quietly supports our determined heroine from behind the scenes.

She is free-spirited and has a personality that is the polar opposite of Asami, but for some reason, they get along well.

She has two brothers who are taken away in the second half of the story.

This is a visual novel where players assume the role of the protagonist and progress through the story.
Enjoy loads of gorgeous artwork, intense scenes, and next-level voice acting as you sit back, relax, and experience the story!
There is also a major choice at the end of the game that affects the ending.
What will become of our heroines Asami and Shuri?!
